spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Taken, taken away, seized.
2 Accepted.
E.
हृ to take, क्त aff.

mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं)
Robbed or stripped of all, entirely ruined.
E.
हृत, and सर्व्वस्व all.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Neglecting one's duty.
2 Deprived of an office, turned out.
3 Barred or deprived of one's right.
E.
हृत, and अधिकार superintendence.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Left without a reply.
E.
हृत, and उत्तर answer.

n. (-ण्डं)
The heart.
E.
हृत्, and पिण्ड lump of flesh.

ind.
Having taken, seized, accepted, &c.
E.
हृ to take, क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-त्स्थः-त्स्था-त्स्थं)
Seated in the heart.
E.
हृत्, and स्थ what stays.
